title: Reduce Yourself To Your First Name
text: [Music] the more effective you are the less titles you need write it down an effective person doesn't need titles nelson mandela is good enough that's why all the great men and women in the bible have no titles we don't even call him by the titles dr reverend bishop moses no just moses what's your problem you're gonna say you know uh archdeacon joshua no just joshua you know why you need titles you ain't doing nothing it's a problem i mean look at the bible daniel said you know malachi micah nahim jeremiah ezekiel daniel jose jober imagine causing calling king david david what's your issue i like this one the best jesus when you are effective in life you reduce yourself to your first name think about it paul just paul peter not bishop pope peter just peter i told my wife years ago i said when i die if you outlive me just put one name on my tombstone miles let the generations come because if my life is not big enough to define that one word to the unborn children i failed live until your first name is enough write it down live in such a way that your first name becomes your life god forgive us everybody wants to be a bishop archbishop arch arch archbishop and i traveled among these people and i'm telling you they ain't doing nothing this guy is a bishop he even ain't got a church i'm like how do you get a bishop man another guy's a bishop he get four members his wife his cousin and his two nephews you know bishop man what are you talking about because i'm an apostle an apostle you got 15 people in a store front man they are sick my name is prophetess sarah prophetess sarah [Applause] you need a pastor to sit you down and let you serve in the children's department for the next four years you're no prophetess let me back off some of you are getting itchy everybody say dominion say it loud shake the roof
